frequency_question: How often has the Federal Reserve successfully raised the CCyB above 0% when economic conditions or policy frameworks suggested its consideration?
membership_rule: Federal Reserve Board of Governors policy decisions regarding the countercyclical capital buffer framework from 2016 (inception of the final rule) through 2026.
coverage_note: 5 major formal reviews or adjustments of the CCyB parameter since rule finalization.
known_gaps: Inter-meeting informal discussions or staff memos are not public; only formal board votes are counted.
skeleton: Total regulatory review cycles for CCyB since 2016 vs instances where the buffer was set or raised above 0%.
multiplier: 1 positive implementation out of 5 major review junctures.
validity_reason: The regulatory framework and voting structure of the Federal Reserve Board regarding capital buffers remain stable across multi-year horizons.
